# Berlin Jazz Week

Date not yet known

![Jazz Band](/binaries/asset/image_assets/2960008/ratio_2_1/1661777092/1000x500/)

© dpa

With a packed programme of concerts over seven days, Berlin will once again become the jazz capital in June.

Jazz Week #9 is once again bringing jazz, improvised music and discussion to the capital. Unlike carefully curated festivals, this year the jazz scene is being called upon to showcase itself from within. With top-notch performers and extraordinary musical combinations, the city’s jazz clubs and open-air venues have risen to the challenge.

# Concerts & tips for gig tripping to Berlin

Music & Festival-Highlights 2026

[Clubs in Berlin](/en/clubs-berlin)   [Concert halls](/en/concert-halls)   [Live music](/en/live-music)

**The Cure**, Tori Amos, Nick Cave, Guns N' Roses, **Foo Fighters**, Materia, Bushido, Helene Fischer and **Giora Feidman** – they're all coming to Berlin in 2026, along with many more. The line-up of megastars in the capital is so extensive that music fans will have to choose between several major concerts on some evenings.

And that's not even taking into account the smaller music events, jazz, classical music, operas, musicals and other exciting [**events in**](/en/events-berlin "Veranstaltungen in Berlin") Berlin. We have compiled some of the concert highlights in Berlin for 2026 for you. Our tips for your big gig in Berlin!

By the way: **Harry Styles fans** **can** already mark their calendars for a visit to Berlin **in 2027** . The superstar is currently on a world tour with his new album and plans to play eight concerts at Berlin's Olympic Stadium. An absolute Berlin record!

## Gig Tripping Highlights 2026

* [Mega concerts](#a1)
* [Rock & pop concerts](#a2)
* [Jazz: Concerts & Festivals](#a3)
* [Highlights for classical music fans](#a4)

## 1. Mega concerts at the Olympic Stadium, Uber Arena & Waldbühne

![Konzert in der Waldbühne](/system/files/styles/visitberlin_content_image_medium_visitberlin_mobile_1x/private/image/Waldb%C3%BChne_GettyImages-908779040_Foto_Sven%20Krobot%20%20EyeEm_DL_PPT_0.jpg.jpg?itok=OhUMWy6P "Konzert in der Waldbühne")

With the [**Velodrom**](/en/velodrom "Velodrom"), Uber Arena, [**Waldbühne and**](/en/waldbuhne-open-air-stage "Waldbühne ") Olympic Stadium, Berlin has four venues that can accommodate more than 10,000 fans.  
  
In 2026, [**Metallica**](/en/event/metallica-m72-world-tour "Metallica") (30 May), **Queens of the Stone Age** (8 July) and Die [**Toten Hosen**](/en/event/die-toten-hosen "Die Toten Hosen") (11 July) will rock the [**Olympic Stadium**](/en/olympic-stadium-berlin "Olympiastadion Berlin"), and [**Lollapalooza**](/en/event/lollapalooza-2027 "Lollapalooza 2026") will once again be held at the Olympic site this year (18 & 19 July 2026). Pitbull, Lewis Capaldi, Lorde, Teddy Swims and Lily Allen will be there with their performance of West End Girl.

**Helene Fischer fans** should already mark **13 June 2026** in their calendars. Tickets for her [**360° stadium tour**](/en/event/helene-fischer-360deg-stadion-tour-2026 "Helene Fischer - 360° Stadion Tour") at Berlin's Olympic Stadium are already on sale.

The **Waldbühne** kicks off on 9 May with Mario Barth, followed by [**Nick Cave**](/en/event/nick-cave-bad-seeds-tour-2026 "Nick Cave") on 30 June, [**Mumford & Sons**](/en/event/mumford-sons "Mumford & Sons") on 9 July and **Sarah Conner** on 15 August. Herbert Grönemeyer and Die Fantastischen Vier have already announced their performances for 2027. You can find more tips on [**hip hop concerts**](https://www.visitberlin.de/de/veranstaltungskalender-berlin?cat%5B%5D=29169&cat%5B%5D=9353&keys=&date_between%5Bmin%5D=&date_between%5Bmax%5D=&district=All&items_per_page=21 "HipHop in Berlin") here.

![Concert](/system/files/styles/visitberlin_content_image_medium_visitberlin_mobile_1x/private/image/Konzert_Fans_GettyImages-873431730_Jena_Ardell_DL_PPT_0.jpg.jpg?itok=gvyIGnVy "Concert")

In 2026, several rock and pop greats will be on stage every month at the [**Uber Arena Berlin**](/en/uber-arena-berlin "Uber Arena"), including [**Bushido**](/node/2258431 "Bushido ")(12 January & 7 March), [**Apache 207**](/node/2234512) (29 January), Eros Ramazzotti (2 March), **Wu-Tang Clan** (3 March), Sarah Connor (14 March), Guns N' Roses (23rd & 25th June), Lenny Kravitz (27th July) and many more.

You can also find a daily updated overview of concerts in Berlin in our [**event calendar**](https://www.visitberlin.de/de/veranstaltungskalender-berlin?cat%5B%5D=29169&keys=&date_between%5Bmin%5D=&date_between%5Bmax%5D=&district=All&items_per_page=21 "Konzerte in Berlin").

## 2. More rock and pop concerts in 2026

![Heimathafen Neukölln](/system/files/styles/visitberlin_content_image_medium_visitberlin_mobile_1x/private/image/10_Jahre_Heimathafen_Saalfoto_Foto_DanielaIncoronato_web.jpg.jpg?itok=idKGER9Q "Heimathafen Neukölln")

In addition to these mega stages, Berlin offers four other concert venues for rock, pop and large events: the [Columbiahalle](/en/columbiahalle-columbia-theater "Columbiahalle"), the [Tempodrom](/en/tempodrom "Tempodrom"), the [Max-Schmeling-Halle](/en/max-schmeling-halle "Max-Schmeling-Halle") and the [Zitadelle Spandau](/en/zitadelle-spandau-spandau-citadel "Zitadelle Spandau"). These venues can accommodate up to 8,000 people in the audience stands. Other exciting music venues include the Parkbühne Wuhlheide, [Huxley's Neue Welt](/en/huxleys-neue-welt "Huxley’s Neue Welt"), the Kesselhaus in the [Kulturbrauerei](/en/kulturbrauerei "Kulturbrauerei"), [Ritter Butzke](/en/ritter-butzke "Ritter Butzke"), the [Festsaal Kreuzberg](/en/festsaal-kreuzberg "Festsaal Kreuzberg"), the [Astra Kulturhaus](/en/astra-kulturhaus "Astra Kulturhaus") and the [Heimathafen Neukölln.](/en/heimathafen-neukolln "Heimathafen Neukölln")

Berlin's [club scene](/en/link-teaser/clubs-berlin "Clubs in Berlin") also has some exciting venues for concerts, including [SO36](/en/so36 "SO36"), [Lido](/en/lido "Lido"), [Silent Green](/en/silent-green-kulturquartier-cultural-quarter "Silent Green"), Frannz Club, Prachtwerk, **Gretchen**, Privatclub, [Urban Spree](/en/urban-spree-berlin "Urban Spree"), [Badehaus and](/en/badehaus-szimpla-szimpla-bathhouse "Badehaus") **Kantine im Berghain**. A list of the most important concerts on the pop and rock scene can be found at the end of the article.

Tortoise are already sold out on 29 January in the large Sendesaal of the RBB.

You can also find an overview of rock and pop concerts in 2026 in our [**event calendar**](https://www.visitberlin.de/de/veranstaltungskalender-berlin?cat%5B%5D=29169&cat%5B%5D=9339&keys=&date_between%5Bmin%5D=&date_between%5Bmax%5D=&district=All&items_per_page=21 "Rock & Pop Konzerte").

## 3. Jazz: Concerts & Festivals in Berlin 2026

![A-Trane jazz club in Berlin](/system/files/styles/visitberlin_content_image_medium_visitberlin_mobile_1x/private/image/A_Trane_c_visitBerlin_Foto_Pierre%20Adenis%20%285%29_web.jpg.jpg?itok=nsyXUUSM "Inside the jazz club A-Trane")

In addition to the concert highlights, music plays every evening in **Berlin's smaller clubs and bars**. In established [**jazz clubs such as**](/en/blog/11-jazz-bars-berlin "11 Jazz Bars in Berlin") A-Trane, Quasimodo, Zig Zag and Yorkschlösschen, you can hear international stars and exciting new projects. Smaller venues as well as established clubs regularly host **jam sessions**, most of them once a week, and the **Hat Bar** even every night from 10.30 pm.

You can also enjoy **the Jazz & Lyrics Festival** at **the** Deutsche Oper (28 February), the [**Berlin XJazz! Festival**](/node/2249214 "Berlin XJazz! Festival 2026") at the Festsaal Kreuzberg (29 to 31 May 2006), at the **Jazzwoche Berlin** (20 to 26 June 2026), or the **Jazzfest Berlin** (29 October to 1 November 2026).

Fans of [**blues and jazz**](https://www.visitberlin.de/de/veranstaltungskalender-berlin?cat%5B%5D=29169&cat%5B%5D=9342&keys=&date_between%5Bmin%5D=&date_between%5Bmax%5D=&district=All&items_per_page=21 "Blues & Jazz in Berlin") will find a comprehensive overview in our calendar of events.

[![Weihnachten voller Ballettzauber](/system/files/styles/visitberlin_ad_embed_visitberlin_mobile_1x/private/image/GCB_465x351_photo.png.jpg?itok=vPgOTG5Z)  

© Grand Classic Ballet](https://grandclassicballet.com/spielplan?state=Berlin+%26+Brandenburg?source=bde)

[Christmas Ballet Magic](https://grandclassicballet.com/spielplan?state=Berlin+%26+Brandenburg?source=bde)  

Experience Swan Lake and The Nutcracker by Grand Classic Ballet in modern productions with live music. December 21-27 at Uber Eats Music Hall, Berlin. Book your tickets now!

[Tickets & dates](https://grandclassicballet.com/spielplan?state=Berlin+%26+Brandenburg?source=bde "Tickets & dates")

## 4. Highlights for classical music fans in Berlin in 2026

![Konzerthaus Berlin - Great Hall](/system/files/styles/visitberlin_content_image_medium_visitberlin_mobile_1x/private/image/Konzerthaus_Berlin_Foto_Uwe_Arens_DL_PPT_0.jpg.jpg?itok=sw7RbRYD "Konzerthaus Berlin - Great Hall")

The world's best symphony orchestras and choirs will be performing in the city during [**the Musikfest Berlin**](/en/event/musikfest-berlin-2026 "Musikfest Berlin 2026") from 28 August to 23 September 2026. Tickets are already available for some concerts, such as those featuring the Kansas City Symphony and the London Symphony Orchestra.

Don't miss the [**festive season at the State Opera**](/de/event/die-festtage-der-staatsoper-berlin "Festtage der Staatsoper") in Berlin's most historic opera house on Unter den Linden. From 28 March to 6 April 2026, you can look forward to unforgettable concerts and opera performances, including new productions of Wagner classics, top-class guest orchestras such as the Vienna Philharmonic and the Orchestre de Paris, and of course the excellent Staatskapelle Berlin.

Another highlight for classical music fans in Berlin is sure to be the [**Berlin Philharmonic's season finale concert**](https://www.berliner-philharmoniker.de/konzerte/kalender/56444/)on 27 June 2026. This time, the Berlin Philharmonic and Kirill Petrenko will transform the **Waldbühne into** a piece of Italy with Viva Italia! And the [**West-Eastern Divan Orchestra**](/en/event/west-eastern-divan-orchestra-daniel-barenboim-yo-yo-ma "West-Eastern Divan Orchestra") will perform under the baton of Daniel Barenboim and together with star cellist Yo-Yo Ma on 13 August 2026.

From 9 to 12 July 2026, [**Classic Open Air**](/en/event/classic-open-air-2027-gendarmenmarkt "Classic Open Air 2026") invites you [**to**](/en/gendarmenmarkt "Gendarmenmarkt") enjoy classical music in the open air against the historic backdrop of [**the Gendarmenmarkt**](/en/gendarmenmarkt "Gendarmenmarkt") . Giovanni Zarrella, Joja Wendt and David Garrett will be there. The series will be opened by **Joana Mallwitz**, chief conductor of the Konzerthausorchester Berlin.

![For A Better World](/system/files/styles/visitberlin_content_image_medium_visitberlin_mobile_1x/private/image/GioraFeidman_MajidMontazer_112025_c_KaiWeise_web.jpg.jpg?itok=Jk9Mlty6)

An unforgettable highlight for klezmer fans is promised by the guest appearance of world-famous clarinettist [**Giora Feidman**](/en/event/giora-feidman-better-world-90th-birthday-concert "Giora Feidman - For a better World") on 25 March 2026 in the Chamber Music Hall. Together with Vytis Šakūras on piano and Chihiro Ishii on violin, Feidman will play "For a Better World" to mark his 90th birthday.

Our event calendar provides an overview of all [**classical concert dates**](/en/category/classical-music "Klassische Konzerte") in Berlin [**in 2026**](/en/category/classical-music "Klassische Konzerte").

## 5. Classical Open Air & Candlelight Concerts 2026 in Berlin

![Soehne Mannheims, Konzert beim Classic open Air 2013 auf dem Gendarmenmarkt in Berlin](/system/files/styles/visitberlin_content_image_medium_visitberlin_mobile_1x/private/image/ClassicOpenAir%20-%20%28c%29%20DAVIDS_web.jpg.jpg?itok=HbY12veu)

The **Classical Open Air in Britzer Garten on** 22 August 2026 is perfect for music-loving families with children.  
  
With currently seven major orchestras, plus the orchestras of the three Berlin opera houses and the Academy of Early Music, Berlin offers an exciting classical music programme all year round. In addition, there are smaller classical music events in some unusual and typically Berlin locations, such as the **Piano Salon Christophori**, a piano workshop.

![Nachtkonzert - Sax in the City -](/system/files/styles/visitberlin_content_image_medium_visitberlin_mobile_1x/private/image/Nachtkonzert_Sax_in_the_City_Foto_Jan_Windszus_Photography_web.jpg.jpg?itok=u_3gR0qi)

**Candlelight concerts**, where you can experience music in atmospheric locations by the light of hundreds of candles, are popular worldwide and, of course, in Berlin too. You can experience an impressive backdrop for live music in the concert halls of the former [**GDR radio station in Nalepastraße**](/en/funkhaus-nalepastrasse "DDR-Funkhaus in der Nalepastraße").

You can hear more insider tips for classical music fans in our [**episode Klassikstadt**](https://open.spotify.com/episode/5gT7n1jkqUqCcsrUmwz5za) Berlin for [**Berlin Unboxed**](/en/berlin-unboxed-visitberlin-podcast "Berlin Unboxed"), the official visitBerlin podcast.

## 6. Festivals & street parties

![Bergmannstraßenfest – Kreuzberg jazzt](/system/files/styles/visitberlin_content_image_medium_visitberlin_mobile_1x/private/image/_Q9C1350_web_0.jpg.jpg?itok=eR8XEoUl)

Music plays everywhere in Berlin, even on the streets and squares of the capital. Highlights every year include the [**Kreuzberg Festival**](/en/event/kreuzberg-festival "Kreuzberg-Festival"), Berlin's largest street festival. From 26 to 28 June 2026, Kreuzbergstraße will be transformed into a musical festival mile with three stages featuring 60 artists and bands. The **48 Hours Neukölln** Festival is also definitely worth a trip to Berlin. From 3 to 5 July 2026, you can spend two days and two nights discovering the musical and artistic sides of this multicultural neighbourhood.

![Karneval der Kulturen](/system/files/styles/visitberlin_content_image_medium_visitberlin_mobile_1x/private/image/karneval1_d_kulturen_c_Daniela_Incoronato_web.jpg.jpg?itok=QyoCB0Xl)

On [**Christopher Street Day**](/en/event/christopher-street-day-2027 "Christopher Street Day 2026") on 26 July, the [**queer community**](/en/gay-berlin-lgbtq-guide-berlin "Queer & Gay Berlin") will dance and celebrate through the city to the sounds of electro and techno. And at [**the Carnival of Cultures**](/en/event/carnival-cultures "Karneval der Kulturen"), the colourful costumes and diverse multicultural music styles will create a lively atmosphere.  
  
Don't miss the **start of summer in** Berlin. For **the Fête de la Musique** on 21 June, the whole city is transformed into a stage. Music is played in the streets, in the parks and also in bars and pubs. Most events are free of charge.

![Fête de la Musique, Lustgarten](/system/files/styles/visitberlin_content_image_medium_visitberlin_mobile_1x/private/image/Fete_de_la_Musique%20Berlin_Lustgarten%C2%A9%20Lars%20Reimann%20Akud_DL_PPT_0.jpg.jpg?itok=t-NRnBAD "Fête de la Musique, Lustgarten")

And if you're interested in pop culture, the **Pop-Kultur Festival** from 24 to 29 August 2026 offers not only concerts and music, but also readings, talks, films and a wide-ranging programme of discussions that place pop culture in a socio-political context.

## 7. Music & electronic festivals in Berlin and the surrounding area

![Lollapalooza Berlin 2015 - Day 1](/system/files/styles/visitberlin_content_image_medium_visitberlin_mobile_1x/private/image/Lollapalooza_Berlin_2015_Atmosphere_19_Jakubaszek_web.jpg.jpg?itok=Ds3Pzv0M)

In addition to [**Lollapalooza**](/en/event/lollapalooza-2027 "Lollapalooza")on 18 & 19 July 2026 on the grounds around the Olympic Stadium, there are a number of music festivals in the Berlin area that can be wonderfully combined with a city trip to Berlin. Among the best known are the **Wurzelfest** 80 kilometres south of Berlin in Jüterborg, the **Hive Festival** and the **Whole** on the Ferropolis grounds, the **Fusion** at the Lärz airfield and the **Feel Festival at** Bergheider See. Look forward to long weekends with music, art, workshops and lovingly designed open-air stages.

## 8. Local & underground tips

![Klunker Kranich mit Blick über Berlin](/system/files/styles/visitberlin_content_image_medium_visitberlin_mobile_1x/private/image/Klunkerkranich_618428262_iStock_Getty%20Images%20Plus_Foto_golero.jpg.jpg?itok=LDPG3_D_ "Blick über Berlin ")

If you want to discover a little more of Berlin than just the big concert halls when gig tripping, you don't have to forego music. Most bars and clubs with [live music](/en/live-music "Live-Musik") can be found in Neukölln, Kreuzberg, Friedrichshain and Mitte. The **Schokoladen on** Ackerstraße in Mitte is a communal living and cultural project with a stage and bar on the ground floor. Here you can still feel the free spirit of the wild 1990s, just like in **the Club der Polnischen Versager** (Club of **Polish** Failures) right next door.

A meeting place for musicians and anyone interested in the subject is the **House of Music** on the RAW site, where there are several other live music venues such as **Cassiopeia**, **Astra and Lokschuppen**. Numerous [**clubs**](/en/clubs-berlin "Clubs in Berlin") also regularly [**host**](/en/clubs-berlin "Clubs in Berlin") live acts on stage. In Neukölln, the [**Klunkerkranich on**](/en/klunkerkranich "Klunkerkranich") the roof of a shopping centre invites you to dance and listen to music, and in Friedrichshain, the **Hoppetosse** rocks **to** electro and jazz sounds on the Spree.

In summer, the music is played outdoors, of course, at Berlin's [beach bars](/en/beach-bars "Strandbars") and [beer gardens](/en/beer-gardens "Biergärten") or just anywhere. Let yourself drift – from the street musicians on Museum Island to the concert series on the [Island of Youth](/en/insel-der-jugend-island-youth "Insel der Jugend ") to a day by the water with music at the Wendeschloss or Grünau beach in Köpenick.

Fancy going out? Then take a look at our overview of the best [**nightlife districts in Berlin**](/en/nightlife-districts-berlin "Ausgehviertel in Berlin").

## 9. Concert highlights 2026

* Icelandic singer **Laufey, 24** February at the Velodrom

### Concert highlights in Berlin in March

* [Belle & Sebastian](https://www.eventim.de/en/event/belle-and-sebastian-belle-sebastian-metropol-20551427/?affiliate=TUG&srsltid=AfmBOopFq9LykWbLNm-CpB6UcCHFrBkTnGTZ8Zy2BNXyWgyBXCfUXck5), 5 March at the Metropol

* [**Giora Feidman**](/en/event/giora-feidman-better-world-90th-birthday-concert "Giora Feidman - For a better World"), 25 March 2026 at the Kammermusiksaal

 🌍 Explora o verdadeiro significado do Fado, um património imaterial da humanidade  
 🇵🇹 Embarca numa viagem pela beleza melancólica de Portugal

 - Sextas-ferias e sábados: Reservatório da Patriarcal

 👉 Consumos: bebidas e tapas disponíveis para compra no Pavilhão Chinês e na EmbaiXada

 Sente a alma de Lisboa! Mergulha numa viagem emocional com concertos memoráveis de Fado no Jardim do Príncipe Real.  ⭐ Magia e emoção na casa onde a eterna Amália Rodrigues viveu durante 44 anos  
 🌷 Um concerto acústico de voz, guitarra portuguesa e viola de fado no seu jardim secreto  
 🤫 Um segredo bem guardado no coração de Lisboa  
 🎁 Um **plano exclusivo Fever**

 **Descrição**  
 A experiência mais autêntica de fado está de volta à Casa da Amália! Haverá melhor lugar para dar continuidade a um dos desejos da Rainha do Fado, do que no jardim da casa onde viveu durante quarenta e quatro anos? Promove o fado e a Portugalidade com uma sessão de fado no seu jardim secreto. Uma casa portuguesa, com certeza! Paredes, cantos e recantos que respiram fado e história. Vais sentir que o tempo parou, Amália Rodrigues está por todas as partes!

# Espectáculo intimista de Fado ao sabor de um Cálice de vinho do Porto

[Comprar Bilhetes](https://widgets.bokun.io/online-sales/ed8d4e32-6117-4b55-8ed7-179e231c8136/experience-calendar/832983)

* [4.8/5 ★★★★★ 1100+](https://g.page/r/CXHKswnZj6yCEBM)

No coração de Lisboa, na Baixa Chiado, apresentamos todas as noites o verdadeiro espírito de Portugal através das vozes únicas dos nossos fantásticos cantores de fado, num espectáculo feito especialmente para si. Desfrute de um brinde com vinho do Porto!

## Fado, Lisboa, Tradições e Lisboa em Fado

Lisboa em Fado nasceu com o propósito de levar o Fado até aos que ainda não conhecem a sua magia. Queremos que todos os que entrem nesta casa se permitam emocionar com a nossa canção e saiam apaixonados por ela.

[Descubra a Nossa História](https://lisboaemfado.pt/pt/sobre/)

## Espectáculos diários de Fado na Baixa Chiado - bilhetes

Preparamos cuidadosamente um espectáculo para si todos os dias, no qual, ao longo de cerca de uma hora, poderá maravilhar-se com o som das guitarras e as vozes dos nossos cantores de fado, e também desfrutar de uma experiência audiovisual que lhe permitirá aprender sobre a história e a evolução do fado até aos dias de hoje.

[Verificar Disponibilidade](https://widgets.bokun.io/online-sales/ed8d4e32-6117-4b55-8ed7-179e231c8136/experience/832983?partialView=1)

![](/uploaded_files/photos/e9257036daf20f062a498aab563d7712_slide_440x810.JPG)

Vela Olímpica

31 jul 2026

## Ya puedes consultar el calendario de regatas de las clases estratégicas 2026-2027

> Septiembre marcará el inicio de una nueva temporada de competición con pruebas repartidas por toda la Comunitat Valenciana

FVCV

La nueva temporada de competición ya está en marcha y las principales clases estratégicas de la Federació de Vela de la Comunitat Valenciana (FVCV) ya tienen definidas sus citas. Desde la Federació hemos trabajado en la planificación de este calendario con el objetivo de que deportistas, equipos técnicos y clubes podáis disponer de las fechas con la mayor antelación posible, organizar vuestras agendas y comenzar a preparar la nueva temporada deportiva.

Septiembre marcará el inicio de un nuevo curso deportivo en el que volver a encontrarse en los campos de regata para afrontar nuevos retos y objetivos. El calendario de las clases estratégicas 2026-2027 recorrerá numerosos clubes náuticos de la Comunitat Valenciana, con pruebas repartidas durante toda la temporada y con una amplia representación territorial.

**Calendario de clases estratégicas 2026-2027:**

**- Clase 420:**

* 17-18 octubre: Club Náutico Oropesa
* 21-22 noviembre: Real Club Náutico Valencia
* 12-13 diciembre: Club Náutico Benidorm
* 23-24 enero: Club Náutico Altea
* 12-14 febrero: Real Club de Regatas de Alicante
* 13-14 marzo: Real Club Náutico Castellón

**- Clase ILCA:**

* 12-13 septiembre: Club Náutico Dehesa Campoamor
* 26-27 septiembre: Real Club Náutico Calpe
* 21-22 noviembre: Real Club Náutico Valencia
* 6-8 diciembre: Real Club de Regatas de Alicante
* 23-24 enero: Club Náutico Altea
* 12-14 febrero: CVSW Youth – Real Club Náutico Valencia
* 19-21 febrero: CVSW – Real Club Náutico Dénia
* 8-9 mayo: Club Náutico Campello

**- Clase Optimist**

Optimist A:

* 19-20 septiembre: Real Club Náutico Valencia
* 24-25 octubre: Club Náutico Dehesa Campoamor
* 28-29 noviembre: Real Club de Regatas de Alicante
* 6-7 febrero: Real Club Náutico Calpe
* 10-11 abril: Club Náutico Alicante Costa Blanca
* 28-30 mayo: Club Náutico Santa Pola

Optimist B:

* 19-20 septiembre: Real Club Náutico Valencia
* 24-25 octubre: Club Náutico Dehesa Campoamor
* 28-29 noviembre: Real Club de Regatas de Alicante
* 9-10 enero: Club Náutico Benidorm
* 3-4 abril: Club Náutico Oliva
* 24-25 abril: Club Náutico Campello

**- Clase Windsurf**

* 26-27 septiembre: Real Club Náutico Torrevieja
* 12-13 diciembre: Club Náutico Benidorm
* 12-14 febrero: CVSW Youth – Real Club Náutico Torrevieja

Con las fechas ya marcadas, comienza una nueva etapa de preparación para todos los regatistas de las clases estratégicas. La FVCV afronta esta nueva temporada con la mirada puesta en seguir impulsando la formación, la competición y el crecimiento deportivo de la vela valenciana.

COSAS DE NIÑOS. PLANES ANTIABURRIMIENTO EN SEVILLA

**COSAS DE NIÑOS. PLANES ANTIABURRIMIENTO EN SEVILLA**

¿Ya no se te ocurre qué hacer con los peques en Sevilla? Te proponemos ideas para todo el año, desde museos y bibliotecas hasta talleres de música y arte.

**ARTE Y MUSEOS**

Para los que disfrutan participando, el programa en familia del **Museo de Bellas Artes de Sevilla** ofrece dos recorridos pensados para niños: uno para edades de 4 a 8 años y otro para los de 8 a 12, además de materiales pedagógicos inspirados en obras concretas de la colección.

El **Museo de las Ilusiones** organiza visitas guiadas y talleres pensados para acercar a los más pequeños fenómenos visuales y sensoriales de forma divertida.

**CaixaForum Sevilla** mantiene una programación familiar constante: talleres de cajón flamenco para aprender el compás desde los 7 años y otras propuestas rotativas ligadas a sus exposiciones temporales.

**LITERATURA**

La **Biblioteca Provincial Infanta Elena** ha reforzado su programación infantil para este curso: sesiones semanales de lectura en voz alta en la sala infantil, talleres de creación literaria como "Poemas de leche" (para niños de 8 a 12 años, centrado en la escritura y el fanzine), narración oral para los más pequeños y jornadas de juegos de mesa en familia.

Las librerías **Baobab** siguen organizando cuentacuentos en distintos puntos de la ciudad (Los Remedios, Santa Justa, Nervión y el Aljarafe). Merece la pena consultar también la programación del centro cívico de cada barrio.

**MÚSICA**

Los talleres de educación musical para escolares de la **Fundación Barenboim** continúan celebrándose un sábado al mes en el Espacio Turina; requieren inscripción previa en la web de la fundación.

**HISTORIA Y PATRIMONIO**

Desde **Engranajes Culturales** proponen visitas pensadas para despertar la curiosidad histórica de los niños, como su recorrido nocturno por el Palacio de las Dueñas (a partir de 12 años).

La **Fundación Valentín de Madariaga** organiza talleres de creación en colaboración con museos y espacios patrimoniales, además de espectáculos de danza y talleres musicales en su sede, antiguo pabellón de Estados Unidos en la Exposición Iberoamericana de 1929.

**OTROS PUNTOS DE INTERÉS**

Y siempre hay otros lugares con actividades interesantísimas como el **Centro Comercial Torre Sevilla** que organiza exposiciones, campus de navidad, ludoteca y talleres de lo más divertidos ¿Que les gusta la ciencia? Pues hay un sitio estupendo, donde pueden disfrutar de experimentos científicos desde pequeños: **Pequeños Alquimistas**. En la **Casa de la Ciencia** pueden asistir a exposiciones y a talleres. Cada nuevo curso escolar inauguran exposiciones temporales con temas de primera actualizad científica. El [Espacio Exploraterra: Museo y Réplica Nao Victoria](https://www.juntadeandalucia.es/cultura/agendaculturaldeandalucia/evento/nao-victoria-500-y-espacio-primera-vuelta-al-mundo) es otro lugar de encuentro abierto a todos los públicos para la difusión de las grandes exploraciones de la Historia. Y el **Parque del Alamillo** acoge ya los consolidados Veranillos de Alamillo, que tampoco te puedes perder.

Y una novedad: la [Ciudad de los Niños](https://www.juntadeandalucia.es/cultura/agendaculturaldeandalucia/espacios/la-ciudad-de-los-ninos-de-sevilla), nuevo parque infantil en el Prado de San Sebastián que rinde homenaje a las fiestas y tradiciones de Sevilla. Se articula en tres áreas temáticas:

* La Gran Pasarela: réplica de 34 m de ancho y 15 m de altura de la antigua portada de la Feria de Abril, con tirolinas, toboganes, rocódromos, redes de trepa y juegos sensoriales.
* El Real de las mini casetas: una calle del Real de Los Remedios a escala infantil, con casetas, farolillos y pañoletas, que esconden barras de juego y toboganes.
* Capirotes para escalar: estructuras con forma de capirotes de nazareno, de distintos colores, con redes de cuerdas para trepar.

# Les événements artistiques à Paris à ne pas manquer ces prochains jours

[![visuel Paris visuel](https://cdn.sortiraparis.com/images/1001/0/01-default.jpg)![visuel Paris visuel](https://cdn.sortiraparis.com/images/1002/0/01-default.jpg)![visuel Paris visuel](https://cdn.sortiraparis.com/images/1003/0/01-default.jpg)![visuel Paris visuel](https://cdn.sortiraparis.com/images/1004/0/01-default.jpg)](https://cdn.sortiraparis.com/images/80/83517/980812-visuel-paris-visuel.jpg "visuel Paris visuel")

Par La rédaction de Sortiraparis · Photos par My de Sortiraparis · Mis à jour le 20 octobre 2026 à 15h57

[Plus de positif dans votre fil Google ? Ajoutez Sortir à Paris.](https://www.google.com/preferences/source?q=sortiraparis.com)

Visite nocturne, festival de photo, Journées du Patrimoine, événement street-art... Quelle que soit la saison, l'art est toujours à la fête à Paris ! Pour ne rien manquer de ces grands rendez-vous culturels, suivez notre guide des événements artistiques parisiens.

A Paris, la **vie culturelle** est toujours en mouvement : **[concerts](/scenes/concert-musique/guides/274211-les-concerts-et-festivals-de-musique-gratuits-a-decouvrir-a-paris-cet-ete),** expositions, spectacles, festivals, **[événements immersifs](/loisirs/jeux-videos/guides/76479-les-meilleurs-escape-games-et-experiences-immersives-a-paris-et-en-ile-de-france)**, jeux... Impossible de s'ennuyer, le programme est bien trop chargé. Cependant, une telle effervescence peut causer des problèmes... Avec toutes ces propositions de sortie, difficile de s'y retrouver ! Emportés par ces activités sans fin, on risque même de laisser passer un événement que l'on attendait pourtant avec impatience. Et ça, c'est inadmissible.

Heureusement, [**Sortiraparis**](https://www.sortiraparis.com/) est là pour vous : nous avons recensé les **événements artistiques à ne pas manquer** à **Paris** et en **Île-de-France.** Centré sur les **musées,** les **expositions,** et les rendez-vous artistiques, ce guide vous permet de connaître et d'anticiper les festivals, les rendez-vous exceptionnels, les événements nationaux et autres rencontres artistiques à vivre en ce moment.

Grce à ce guide, il n'est plus question de manquer un événement en rapport avec l'art à Paris. Vous pouvez donc d'ores et déjà sortir vos agendas, et prévoir vos prochaines sorties culturelles. Nous vous partageons tous les **rendez-vous incontournables** du moment, pour vivre et découvrir l'art autrement.

Ce guide est **mis à jour régulièrement**, en fonction des nouvelles annonces et des programmes dévoilés. N'hésitez pas à mettre cette page en **favori,** pour pouvoir retrouver facilement votre agenda des événements artistiques à Paris et en Île-de-France !

> [**Les événements à vivre en ce moment**](#maintenant)
>
> [**Les événements à noter dans son agenda**](#avenir)

**Les événements à vivre en ce moment :**

Sponsorisé - Depuis le 24 septembre 2026 et jusqu'au 31 janvier 2027, pop art car 2.0 investit le défilé renault®, au 53 avenue des Champs-Élysées à Paris. # Sortir à Paris en octobre 2026 : les belles expositions à voir en ce moment dans la capitale

[![Rafael Pavarotti](https://cdn.sortiraparis.com/images/1001/0/01-default.jpg)![Rafael Pavarotti](https://cdn.sortiraparis.com/images/1002/0/01-default.jpg)![Rafael Pavarotti](https://cdn.sortiraparis.com/images/1003/0/01-default.jpg)![Rafael Pavarotti](https://cdn.sortiraparis.com/images/1004/0/01-default.jpg)](https://cdn.sortiraparis.com/images/80/115049/1321703-rafael-pavarotti.jpg "Rafael Pavarotti")

Par La rédaction de Sortiraparis · Photos par Audrey de Sortiraparis · Mis à jour le 22 octobre 2026 à 10h29

[Plus de positif dans votre fil Google ? Ajoutez Sortir à Paris.](https://www.google.com/preferences/source?q=sortiraparis.com)

Alors, quelles sont les nouvelles expositions à voir à Paris et en Île-de-France en octobre 2026 ? Les musées nous donnent rendez-vous pendant tout ce mois pour découvrir les magnifiques expositions et événements au programme.

À la recherche d'une**[sortie à faire en octobre 2026](/actualites/a-paris/guides/77600-que-faire-a-paris-en-octobre-2019)** à Paris ? Ce guide est fait pour vous ! Mode, photo, histoire, peinture, sculpture, moderne, ancien... Il y a forcément une **exposition** qui saura vous plaire dans les musées et galeries de la région. Plusieurs dizaines de sorties culturelles et artistiques s'offrent à vous, vous n'avez que l'embarras du choix !

En cette jolie saison de l'**[automne](/actualites/a-paris/guides/283237-les-sorties-et-activites-gratuites-a-paris-et-en-ile-de-france-pour-cet-automne)**, laissez-vous séduire par cette ambiance confortable, ces belles couleurs qui ornent les arbres, ces chocolats chauds... Et embarquez dans une promenade onirique au milieu des plus belles œuvres du monde ! Et si, pour vous, l'ambiance d'**[Halloween](/actualites/halloween/guides/283640-halloween-2022-dans-les-musees-et-chateaux-de-paris-et-d-ile-de-france)** est plutôt associée aux sorcières et aux fantômes, réjouissez-vous : on peut également en trouver dans les musées et dans les galeries d'art. On vous le dit : il y a des expositions pour tout le monde à Paris !

Et pour combler encore un peu plus nos envies artistiques, profitez des nombreux **événements** organisés ces prochains jours dans la région. En **famille,** entre **amis** ou en **solo,** vous ne risquez pas de vous ennuyer. Un mois sous le signe de la culture à ne manquer sous aucun prétexte... On le note dans son agenda, les amis ?

### Les incontournables du mois :

L'Expo des 150 et StreetArt Denfert se dévoilent dans l'ancien Zara de Denfert-Rochereau, à Paris 14e. On a pu glisser un œil en avant-première sur cette immense expo street art gratuite, à découvrir du 3 au 25 octobre 2026. Attention, l'accès est sur inscription gratuite, prenez vos places ! # 東京、11月に行くべきジャズイベント5選

ドラムの神によるグルーヴからZ世代ジャズの新潮流まで

[Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/sharer/sharer.php?u=https://www.timeout.jp/tokyo/ja/music/jazz-events-in-november)[Twitter](https://twitter.com/intent/tweet/?text=%E6%9D%B1%E4%BA%AC%E3%80%8111%E6%9C%88%E3%81%AB%E8%A1%8C%E3%81%8F%E3%81%B9%E3%81%8D%E3%82%B8%E3%83%A3%E3%82%BA%E3%82%A4%E3%83%99%E3%83%B3%E3%83%885%E9%81%B8&url=https://www.timeout.jp/tokyo/ja/music/jazz-events-in-november)[Pinterest](https://www.pinterest.co.uk/pin/create/button/?url=https://www.timeout.jp/tokyo/ja/music/jazz-events-in-november)[Email](mailto:?subject=%E6%9D%B1%E4%BA%AC%E3%80%8111%E6%9C%88%E3%81%AB%E8%A1%8C%E3%81%8F%E3%81%B9%E3%81%8D%E3%82%B8%E3%83%A3%E3%82%BA%E3%82%A4%E3%83%99%E3%83%B3%E3%83%885%E9%81%B8&body=%E6%9D%B1%E4%BA%AC%E3%80%8111%E6%9C%88%E3%81%AB%E8%A1%8C%E3%81%8F%E3%81%B9%E3%81%8D%E3%82%B8%E3%83%A3%E3%82%BA%E3%82%A4%E3%83%99%E3%83%B3%E3%83%885%E9%81%B8 https://www.timeout.jp/tokyo/ja/music/jazz-events-in-november.)[WhatsApp](whatsapp://send?text=%E6%9D%B1%E4%BA%AC%E3%80%8111%E6%9C%88%E3%81%AB%E8%A1%8C%E3%81%8F%E3%81%B9%E3%81%8D%E3%82%B8%E3%83%A3%E3%82%BA%E3%82%A4%E3%83%99%E3%83%B3%E3%83%885%E9%81%B8%20https://www.timeout.jp/tokyo/ja/music/jazz-events-in-november)

[![Kosuke Hori](https://media.timeout.com/images/106294814/170/170/image.jpg)](https://www.timeout.com/profile/kosuke-hori)

編集 [Kosuke Hori](https://www.timeout.com/profile/kosuke-hori)

Editor

テキスト: [Naoya Koike](https://www.timeout.com/profile/naoya-koike)

広告

[タイムアウト東京](http://www.timeout.jp/tokyo/ja) > [音楽](http://www.timeout.jp/tokyo/ja/music) > 東京、11月に行くべきジャズイベント5選

秋が深まる11月、東京の夜に円熟と挑戦の音が鳴る。

「ドラムの神」と称されるスティーヴ・ガッド（Steve Gadd）のグルーヴから、「即興」を主題としたフェスティバル、Z世代の若手ミュージシャンたちによるジャズの新潮流まで──。

伝統と革新が交錯する都市・東京で、ジャズの百花繚乱を体感してほしい。

**関連記事**  
『[ジャズバー入門ガイド、グラス片手に楽しむ選曲と生演奏の醍醐味とは](https://www.timeout.jp/tokyo/ja/music/beginners-guide-to-jazz-bar)』  
『[東京、ジャズハウス10選](https://www.timeout.jp/tokyo/ja/music/jazzhouse)』

## ジャズをもっと聴きたいなら……

[### 東京、ジャズバー7選](/tokyo/ja/music/tokyo-jazz-bar)

* 音楽

[Photo: Keisuke Tanigawa](/tokyo/ja/music/tokyo-jazz-bar)

針で引っかいて音を出すというアナログなレコードの手法に、ジャズの音は非常に合う。そして、そこにアルコールが加われば言うまでもない。

本記事では、モダンやニューオリンズジャズを流す老舗はもちろん、フリーやDJカルチャーを通過した新時代のジャズを流すヴェニューも紹介。ジャズという音楽の奥深さにきっと気づかされることだろう。もちろん深いことは考えず、ただ音に身を委ねるのも一興だ。本記事で新たな出合いがあることを願う。

[詳細情報](/tokyo/ja/music/tokyo-jazz-bar)

[### 東京、ジャズハウス10選](/tokyo/ja/music/jazzhouse)

* 音楽

[サムタイム](/tokyo/ja/music/jazzhouse)

数多くのジャズライブハウスが点在している東京。毎夜都内で行われるジャズライブの数は50以上もあると言われている。それゆえ、初心者は店選びに迷い、敷居の高さに腰が引けてしまうことも多いだろう。ここで紹介するジャズハウスは、間違いなく訪れる価値のある場所なので、参考にしてほしい。

[詳細情報](/tokyo/ja/music/jazzhouse)

広告

[### 東京、くつろぎのジャズ喫茶6選](/tokyo/ja/music/tokyo-jazzkissa)

* 音楽
* ジャズ

[Photo: Manabu Morooka](/tokyo/ja/music/tokyo-jazzkissa)

ジャズの鑑賞を主体に、コーヒーが楽しめるジャズ喫茶。その元祖は、1929年に本郷でオープンした「ブラックバード」だといわれている。

同時期でいえば、1933年に創業した横浜の「[ちぐさ](https://www.noge-chigusa.com/)」は一度の閉店を挟みながらも、2022年まで約90年にわたって営業してきた。同店には、若き日の秋吉敏子や渡辺貞夫、日野皓正らジャズミュージシャンたちが足繁く通い、アメリカ軍のクラブでの演奏のかたわら、当時高価だったレコードを聴いて勉強していたという。もちろん、プレイヤーだけでなく、ジャズファンにとっても最新のジャズを仕入れられる場だったのだろう。

そんなジャズ喫茶は、日本におけるミュージックバーのルーツともいえるし、踊ることを主目的としていない「リスニングイベント」という概念の始祖でもあるかもしれない。2010年代以降のレコードブームや、漫画『BLUE GIANT』のヒット以降は、若い世代も以前より訪れるような印象を受ける。

本記事では、店主の音楽への真摯（しんし）な姿勢やアットホームな雰囲気、素晴らしいオーディオシステムをほこる店など、おすすめをピックアップした。ぜひ足を運んでみてほしい。

[詳細情報](/tokyo/ja/music/tokyo-jazzkissa)

[### ジャズバー入門ガイド、グラス片手に楽しむ選曲と生演奏の醍醐味とは](/tokyo/ja/music/beginners-guide-to-jazz-bar)

* 音楽

[Photo: Keisuke Tanigawa | サックス奏者の馬場智章（左）とノールームフォースクエアーズの店主・仲田晃平](/tokyo/ja/music/beginners-guide-to-jazz-bar)

映画『BLUE GIANT』の主人公の演奏を担当した、サックス奏者の馬場智章と、現代ジャズシーンを支えているヴェニューの下北沢「No Room For Squares（ノールームフォースクエアーズ）」（以下：ノールーム）の店主である仲田晃平。プレイヤー、そして店のスタッフとして現場に立つ2人に、ジャズバーの楽しみ方について聞いてみた。

対談は、人生で初めていったジャズバーやいつも頼む決まった一杯などから、ジャズを取り巻く場についてまで話は及んだ。時間とお金をかけて、音楽とじっくり向き合う。そんな場に足を運ぶことこそ、贅沢な時間の使い方なのかもしれない。

週末といわず今夜、グラス片手にジャズを聴くために街へ繰り出そう。

[詳細情報](/tokyo/ja/music/beginners-guide-to-jazz-bar)

広告

[### 「阿佐谷ジャズストリート」開催中に訪れたい、とっておきのジャズバー3選](/tokyo/ja/music/besr-jazz-bar-in-asagaya)

* 音楽
* ジャズ

[Photo: Naoya Koike](/tokyo/ja/music/besr-jazz-bar-in-asagaya)

今年も阿佐ケ谷の街がジャズ一色に染まるイベント「[阿佐谷ジャズストリート](https://www.timeout.jp/tokyo/ja/%E9%9F%B3%E6%A5%BD/asagaya-jazz-street)」が開催される。今年で30回目の今回はJR中央線の阿佐ヶ谷駅を中心に、駅前の広場、学校の体育館、幼稚園の園庭、教会、会社のロビー、区役所前の広場など多くの会場でジャズのコンサートが行われる。

パブリック会場や街中でスイングするのも良いけれど、せっかくなら歴史が染み込んだジャズバーで即興的なハプニングを目撃しよう。

今回は、タイムアウトに多くの音楽記事を寄稿するライター・小池直也が選んだ3件を紹介。イベントが開催される2025年10月24日（金）・25日（土）には各ヴェニュー独自のジャズイベントが開催されるので、ぜひ立ち寄ってほしい。

[詳細情報](/tokyo/ja/music/besr-jazz-bar-in-asagaya)

* [X Twitter](https://twitter.com/share?url=https%3A%2F%2Fjazin.net%2F%3Fp%3D3630&text=MET+JAZZ+TOKYO%E8%AA%95%E2%BD%A3%EF%BC%81%E3%83%97%E3%83%AC%E3%82%B3%E3%83%B3%E3%82%B5%E3%83%BC%E3%83%88%E3%81%8C11%E6%9C%8829%E3%81%AB%E9%96%8B%E5%82%AC)

* 2026年07月28日
* NEWS

19 世紀末、ヨーロッパ、アフリカ、南⽶やカリブ海など、世界の多様な⽂化が出会う港町ニューオーリンズで⽣まれたジャズは、ミシシッピ川を上って全⽶に広まりました。ジャズはやがて海を越え、世界各地の⽂化と結びつきながら、常に新たな芸術を創出してきました。ニューヨーク、パリ、ロンドン、イスタンブール、ソウル……。世界を代表する都市には、その地域を象徴するジャズフェスティバルが存在します。それらはジャズのレガシーを⼤切に継承しつつ、地域固有の⽂化や最先端のシーンを柔軟に取り込み、現在進⾏形のジャズを発信して次世代へとバトンを渡し続けています。  
 さまざまな⾳楽ジャンルや地域⽂化を吸収しながら進化してきたジャズは、即興（アドリブ）を重ねていくスタイルにより、国境も⽂化も超越します。そのダイバーシティ（多様性）に満ちあふれた⾳楽は、演奏する側だけでなく、聴く側の想像⼒と創造⼒をも豊かに育むものです。  
 「次世代を⽣き抜くパワー」を持ったこの⾳楽⽂化を、確実に未来へと繋いでいくことを願い、2027年5⽉、東京から世界に向けて発信する新たなジャズフェスティバル「MET JAZZ TOKYO」を始動します。  
 新たなフェスティバルの名称「MET」には、国際都市「METROPOLITAN」東京において、国境や世代を超えて⼈と⼈、⼈と⾳楽が「MEET（出会う）」する場を創出したいという願いが込められています。

【名称】 MET JAZZ TOKYO FESTIVAL（略称：MET JAZZ TOKYO）  
 【開催時期】 2027年5⽉28⽇（⾦）〜30⽇（⽇）  
 【会場】 NHK ホール、LINE CUBE SHIBUYA（渋⾕公会堂）、WWWX / WWW、渋⾕区⽂化総合センター⼤和⽥ ほか  
 【主催】 MET JAZZ TOKYO実⾏委員会  
 【企画・プロデューサー】 ⼋島敦⼦（エイトアイランズ株式会社）  
 【アンバサダー】 上原ひろみ

SPECIAL ANNOUNCEMENT

それに先駆け  
 「MET JAZZ TOKYO プレコンサート」開催決定！

MET JAZZ TOKYO アンバサダー上原ひろみキュレーションのもと世界も注⽬する⽇本のジャズシーンの「いまとこれから」を担うミュージシャンたちが集合。

# Mozart, Beethoven, Haydn and Schubert in St. Anna

[![Venue](/images/venue-form.svg)St Anne Church Vienna](/en/venue/st-anne-church-vienna-270)

[![Calendar](/images/calendar-sus-galben.svg)Thu 22 Oct 2026 - Wed 31 Mar 2027](#tickets)

[Synopsis/Details](#synopsis)

[Venue](#venue)

[Seating plan](/img/30087st-pl.png)

[Buy tickets](#tickets)

Synopsis/Details

The classical concerts are presented in the form of string quartets and include specific pieces of chamber music.

An insider's tip in the city of art and culture, which ensures an exceptional evening to all music lovers and represents one of the highlights during a Vienna visit.

The St. Anne Church is a historical proof of the beauty and playfulness of the Baroque. It provides a magnificent and authentic atmosphere and lends the concert a high-quality and refined setting. Thereby, the music achieves exceptional quality that leads the audience to dreamy listening.

Our musicians acquired their art skills at some of the best-known music academies in Europe and play in concerts with renowned Viennese orchestras. Do not miss an attendance, because selected works by Mozart, & Beethoven and other composers who have lived and worked in Vienna are best interpreted in our cycle of concerts.

With an approach to this epoch by the use of an authentic as possible instruments and an employment of the performance practice we offer our guests to experience the compositions of the time of Mozart, Beethoven and Schubert in a tonally exciting way. In this context we present Franz Schubert’s greatest work of chamber music “Death and the Maiden” on historical instruments, which we highly recommend.

Please note that the church is heated!

Venue

![](/imagini/520x380/32276annakirche.jpg)

St Anne Church Vienna

St. Anne's Church (German: Annakirche) is located in Vienna, Austria, and has been administered by the Oblates of St. Francis de Sales since 1906. A relic of Saint Anne—her right hand—is kept in a rich Baroque setting and exhibited every year on July 26.

St. Anne's chapel existed since 1320. In 1518, the Gothic church was consecrated on the occasion of Saint Anne's Day (26 July). The church was administered first by the Poor Clare Sisters, then by the Jesuits. Between 1629 and 1634, the Jesuits started the Baroquisation of the Gothic church. After a fire in 1747, Pozzo's pupil Christoph Tausch transformed it into late baroque using trompe l'oeil techniques. On 25 June 1747 lightning struck the tower of the church, burning down the roof framing but leaving intact the frescos. In 1751, Daniel Gran began the renovation of the interior, blackened by candle smoke. After starting to work in the church in 1897, the Oblates of St. Francis de Sales received the church in 1906.

The city turns inward in November. Concerts in Vienna in November 2026 take place in a Vienna that is colder, darker, and noticeably calmer — and the music responds to that mood. The full concert season runs at peak intensity, but with a quieter, more reflective atmosphere than the busier shoulder months. ## Reflection, Sacred Repertoire, and the Approach to Advent

November begins with All Saints' Day, and the early-month programming often carries an introspective edge. Sacred works — requiems, masses, motets — appear more often in the central churches, including Stephansdom, Peterskirche, and Karlskirche, where the architecture suits the season. The major halls continue at full intensity with ambitious symphonic and choral repertoire, and the Mozart and chamber circuit runs without pause. By the last days of the month, Advent programming begins to colour the calendar with the first Christmas-themed concerts of the year.

## Cool, Damp, and Made for Indoor Music

Vienna in November averages around 9 °C by day and 4 °C at night, with rain on roughly eight days and the first occasional snowflakes possible by month's end. Sunset comes early — close to 16:30 in the final week — which steers nearly every concert into proper evening territory. Warm outerwear is essential, especially for the walk to and from venues, and church interiors call for an extra layer.

  
   

## Frequently Asked Questions

  

#### Are there Advent concerts in Vienna already in November?

Yes, in the final week. Many churches and concert venues begin their Christmas-themed programming with the start of Advent, which in some years falls in late November. The biggest cluster of Christmas concerts builds through December, but November carries the opening notes.

  

#### Is November a quiet month for Vienna concerts?

The audiences are quieter — fewer tourists, more local concertgoers — but the programming is at full intensity. Many regulars consider November the most rewarding atmosphere of the year: serious music, focused audiences, easier last-minute availability than in spring.

  

#### Should I book Vienna concerts ahead of time for November?

For prestige opera, weekend programs, and the first Advent concerts at central churches: yes. For mid-week chamber and Mozart concerts: availability is often comfortable, though booking ahead through Classictic.com still gives the cleanest choice of seats.

title: Christmas concerts in Vienna 2026
raw_content:
[An \* means an affiliate relationship; see footer]  
  
[City guide](https://www.visitingvienna.com/visitorinfo/introduction-to-vienna/) | [Search the site](https://www.visitingvienna.com/search/) | [Tips for September](https://www.visitingvienna.com/entertainment/september)

[Visiting Vienna](https://www.visitingvienna.com/)

# Christmas concert listings

A Viennese Christmas is about the lights, the sights, the smells…and the sounds. Expect fewer sleigh bells and more violins, though: after all, you’re in the concert capital of classical music.

Here are my tips for finding the best classical concert, church and choir performances during the Advent season.

* Book a [Christmas concert experience](https://www.tiqets.com/en/concerts-opera-vienna-tickets-l206741/?partner=visitingvienna&tq_campaign=LG_Xmas)\* for your trip
* See also:
  + [Shows & musicals](https://www.visitingvienna.com/entertainment/shows-and-musicals/)
  + [December in Vienna](https://www.visitingvienna.com/entertainment/december/)
  + [Christmas in Vienna](https://www.visitingvienna.com/entertainment/christmas-in-vienna/)
  + [Concert dress codes](https://www.visitingvienna.com/entertainment/events/classical-concert-dress-code/)

Jump to:

* [Mozart, Strauss & light classical](#mozart)
* [Church & cathedral concerts](#churches)
* [Musikverein](#musikverein)
* [Konzerthaus](#konzerthaus)
* [The opera houses](#opera)
* [Concerts elsewhere](#other)
* [Christmas markets](#markets)
* [Choirs](#choirs)

## Classical concerts for 2026

Goodness, Vienna has so many. All the [popular venues](https://www.visitingvienna.com/entertainment/classical-concert/) continue their concert programmes through late November and December.

However, below I list Christmas-themed highlights from the major concert & church locations as I come across them, as well as details of some smaller and seasonal venues.

At the time of writing (early June), event schedules are still not complete. So come back later for updates.

### Mozart & more for visitors

(The [Alte Börse](https://www.visitingvienna.com/entertainment/alte-borse/) old stock market…now a venue)

Throughout the year, various orchestras and ensembles perform the music of Mozart, Strauss and/or other famous composers with visitors in mind.

[These concerts](https://www.visitingvienna.com/entertainment/classical-concert/#mozart-strauss-concerts) typically feature accessible, light classical music in an authentic historical venue. Seasonal changes to the usual routine are common, with many such venues offering [special Christmas concerts](https://www.tiqets.com/en/vienna-christmas-new-years-eve-concerts-tickets-l254313/?partner=visitingvienna&tq_campaign=LG_Xmas)\*.

### Concerts in churches

Many churches hold advent concerts and choral recitals through December. Here are some of the more popular locations…

#### Stephansdom

(This Viennese landmark dominates the centre of town)

The [grand cathedral](https://www.visitingvienna.com/sights/stefansdom/) is the heart of the city and obviously worth visiting in its own right or to attend, for example, one of the regular [giant organ concerts](https://www.visitingvienna.com/entertainment/stephansdom-organ-concerts/).

Expect a dozen or so additional [seasonal concerts](https://www.tiqets.com/en/st-stephen-s-cathedral-concerts-tickets-l238032/?partner=visitingvienna&tq_campaign=LG_Xmas)\* from late November through to Christmas. The Wiener Symphoniker orchestra usually holds an annual Advent Concert there, too.

#### Peterskirche

(The dome mirrors that of its Vatican namesake)

A beautiful [baroque church](https://www.visitingvienna.com/sights/peterskirche/) in the centre, which hosts concerts in the church itself and also in the crypt.

Notable for the [regular performances](https://www.visitingvienna.com/entertainment/events/classic-ensemble-review/) by the Classic Ensemble Vienna (I attended with a friend and thoroughly enjoyed the concert), which continue through December.

#### Karlskirche

(The entrance is actually on the right hand side)

The mighty and magnificent [baroque church](https://www.visitingvienna.com/sights/karlskirche/) on Karlsplatz square also has a fair few concerts in the advent season programme.

In December 2026, for example, the Orchestra 1756 put on [regular evening performances](https://www.visitingvienna.com/entertainment/events/vivaldi-concert-karlskirche/) of Vivaldi’s *The Four Seasons*.

#### Minoritenkirche

(This ancient bastion dates back to the 1200s)

Home to the Italian congregation in Vienna, this [large gothic church](https://www.visitingvienna.com/entertainment/minoritenkirche/) also sits in the city centre.

Unlike many similar locations, the [Christmas concerts](https://www.tiqets.com/en/vienna-attractions-c60335/tickets-for-minorite-church-classical-concert-p1104980/?partner=visitingvienna&tq_campaign=LG_Xmas)\* tend to be an eclectic mix of different performers and works (so check the programme for what’s happening on any one day).

#### Kapuzinerkirche

(Home to many former Emperors and Empresses)

In 2026, the Wiener Kaiserquartett & Friends perform a selection of seasonal music and songs in the [Capuchin Church](https://www.visitingvienna.com/sights/kapuzinerkirche-capuchin-church/) on various dates from late November to the end of December.

The church sits above the [Imperial Crypt](https://www.visitingvienna.com/sights/kapuzinergruft/). So you can enjoy some festive classical music and also see the last resting place of those who ruled at the time the pieces were written.

#### Annakirche

(The interior decoration in the Annakirche is mindblowing)

And [another gorgeous church](https://www.visitingvienna.com/sights/annakirche/) in the old town with concerts typically focusing on the peak era of Viennese classical music (think Beethoven, Schubert, Mozart, etc.).

The previous three Advents also had festive tunes performed on trumpets. And the trumpets [return in 2026](https://www.tiqets.com/vienna-attractions-c60335/tickets-for-st-annes-church-magic-trumpet-christmas-concert-p1091613?partner=visitingvienna&tq_campaign=LG_Xmas)\*.

#### Votivkirche

(Impressive, but not as old as it looks!)

The Light of Creation [immersive light & music show](https://www.tiqets.com/en/vienna-attractions-c60335/tickets-for-light-of-creation-new-immersive-lightshow-at-votive-church-vienna-p1109003/?partner=visitingvienna&tq_campaign=LG_Xmas)\* at the church continues across advent. I’ve not been myself, but heard good things about it from friends.

In 2026, this [neo-gothic giant](https://www.visitingvienna.com/sights/votivkirche/) also has, for example, performances by Stella Jones & The American Christmas Gospel.

*Ad:*

### The Musikverein

(The façade above the front entrance)

The [Musikverein](https://www.visitingvienna.com/entertainment/musikverein/) ranks as probably the world’s most prestigious and best classical music venue. They have daily “normal” performances, but seasonal events and concerts always pop up.

The Wiener Mozart Orchestra [performs here](https://www.tiqets.com/en/wiener-musikverein-tickets-l72533/?partner=visitingvienna&tq_campaign=LG_Xmas)\* across much of Advent 2026 in period costume, too.

Other (Christmas-specific) performances include:

* *Christmas im Wiener Musikverein* (December 15th) featuring the Cappella Istropolitana orchestra and soloist singers

* *The Sound of Christmas* (December 22nd) featuring the Imperial Philharmonic orchestra

If we stretch out the concept of the Christmas period a little, then a reliable annual constant is the rather excellent [New Year’s Concert](https://www.visitingvienna.com/entertainment/events/new-years-concert/) from the Wiener Philharmoniker.

This major cultural event traditionally takes place on December 30th and 31st, as well as January 1st. Though you must have applied for tickets early in the year to have a chance of attending.

(More info and tickets on Musikverein events available at their website.)

### The Konzerthaus

(The Konzerthaus main entrance)

Another prestigious venue is the [Konzerthaus](https://www.visitingvienna.com/entertainment/konzerthaus/), which usually has a more eclectic advent choice.

The venue always hosts *Christmas in Vienna*: the rather-apt title of a traditional gala music event held annually. The 2026 dates are December 16th (preview edition) and December 17th (the main event).

International singers typically accompany, for example, the Vienna Boys Choir, the Konzerthaus’s own choir (the Wiener Singakademie), and the ORF Radio Symphony Orchestra for a seasonal sing-song and feel-good evening of entertainment.

The program can range from traditional carols and songs to pop classics, opera arias, and orchestral compositions.

Should you miss out on tickets, the national broadcaster (ORF) usually shows it on TV (as do many other countries, I believe).

Other Christmas-themed performances scheduled at the time of writing include:

* *Am Weihnachtsabend* (December 9th) with the Jazzrausch Bigband

* *Soulful Advent* (December 9th) with Jocelyn B. Smith & Band

* *Advent with Elīna Garanča* (December 10th) featuring the opera great along with, for example, the ORF Radio Symphony Orchestra and the Wiener Singakademie

* The *Spirit of Christmas tour 2026* (December 11th) with singer Gregory Porter

* *Swinging Christmas* (December 12th) with the Gerhard Aflenzer Broadway Big Band and singers

* *A Sisters Christmas* (December 16th) where the Schick Sisters and guests perform Christmas classics and their own compositions

* *Frohe Weihnachten & God Jul* (December 19th) featuring the Tanzgeiger, Helene Blum, Harald Haugaard & guests

* *Buon Natale* (December 20th) featuring Christmas songs from around the world with tenor Paolo Scariano and others

* *Bach’s Christmas Oratorio Parts I, II, IV & VI* (December 20th, 21st & 22nd) with the prestigious Wiener Symphoniker orchestra

* *The Sound of Christmas* (December 21st) with the Homin choir performing international Christmas songs

* *Ukrainian Christmas* (December 22nd) with the Homin choir

(More info and tickets for Konzerthaus events available at their website.)

*Ad:*

### The opera houses

* The [Staatsoper](https://www.visitingvienna.com/entertainment/opera/staatsoper/) performs Strauss’s *Die Fledermaus* on New Year’s Eve (and again on January 1st)

* The [Volksoper](https://www.visitingvienna.com/entertainment/opera/volksoper/) has its traditional Christmas concert on December 14th (twice)

### Bonus Concerts in Museums etc.

One intriguing option is the [Fever candlelight concerts](https://www.visitingvienna.com/entertainment/events/candlelight-concerts/), which typically feature classical interpretations of popular or modern music, along with more classical evenings that fit the time of year.

Venues around Christmas include the likes of the Weltmuseum, the refurbished Sofiensäle, and Palais Ferstel.

#### The amateur tradition

A special bonus mention for the [Concentus21 orchestra](https://www.concentus21.at/), as they uphold the Viennese tradition of amateur orchestras and musicians.

The orchestra usually brings us a special performance at Advent. On November 28th, 2026, it will be Mozart’s *Piano Concerto No. 17* in G major and Mozarts’s *Symphony No.40* in G minor.

#### The Mozarthaus

This is where Mozart [once lived](https://www.visitingvienna.com/footsteps/mozarthaus/) and the location of the main museum dedicated to the composer. Keep an eye out for [concerts there](https://www.visitingvienna.com/entertainment/bosendorfer-saal/). The Wiener Ensemble, for example, typically plays many dates in December.

Frankly, it’s rather cool listening to, for example, Mozart’s music in the same house he composed it in.

### The Christmas markets

(The entrance to the Christkindlmarkt)

Keep an ear open when visiting the various [Christmas markets](https://www.visitingvienna.com/sightseeing/christmas-markets/), as several may have public music performances.

Promising options include the [Christkindlmarkt](https://www.visitingvienna.com/sights/christmasmarkets/rathausplatz/): the main market in front of the Rathaus (city hall) had brass ensembles performing most days in the evening last time out. See also choir singing below.

### Choirs

#### Vienna Boys’ Choir

The Wiener Sängerknaben tend to be quite busy at the end of the year. The choir’s [website](https://www.wsk.at/termine) has a calendar of all their performances, with appearances in the [Hofburg court chapel](https://www.visitingvienna.com/sights/winter-palace/hofburgkapelle/) usually continuing through advent.

Check the [website](https://muth.at/) of their own venue for in-house events, which typically include several Christmas performances by the choir.

#### Rathaus

(Imposing architecture and international choirs)

In 2025, the main hall of the [neogothic Rathaus](https://www.visitingvienna.com/sights/rathaus-2/) behind the Christkindlmarkt hosted choirs on Advent weekends (Fridays to Sundays). We had performances from 3.30pm to 7pm. Entry was free and over 80 choirs from around the world participated. A similar event is planned for 2026.

### Still not found something?

Simply keep your eyes open for flyers and posters as you wander through the city centre! And check my broader [guide to Christmas 2026 in Vienna](https://www.visitingvienna.com/entertainment/christmas-in-vienna/) for other activity and event suggestions.

## About us

🚀 Startup Valley: Startup Networking  
 A global community of startups, investors, and tech leaders. We bring together entrepreneurs, venture capitalists, and experts so you can:  
 ✅ Connect with investors and partners  
 ✅ Pitch your startup and get valuable feedback  
 ✅ Stay updated on trends in Tech, AI, Web3, and FinTech  
 ✅ Expand your professional network  
 ✅ Solve challenges through insights from experienced entrepreneurs  
 📍 Networking, pitches, and industry insights—all in one place!  
 🔗 Join us and stay at the forefront of innovation!  
[https://startupvalley.club](https://startupvalley.club/)

[![Image 7: Tech & Business Networking in Amsterdam](https://secure.meetupstatic.com/photos/event/e/a/0/c/highres_533279916.jpeg) ### Tech & Business Networking in Amsterdam Thu, Oct 29 · 6:00 PM CET I-Dock restaurant, bar & marina terrace, IJdok 4 , 1013 MM, Amsterdam, NL 📍 **Registration is on Luma — Meetup is not our RSVP platform.** Please register here to secure your spot: https://luma.com/nff43vdg 🚀 **Join our event in Amsterdam!** We design Pitch and Networking nights to help founders sharpen their thinking through direct, candid feedback and to give strong investors access to serious teams. **Our pitch night is complemented by a structured networking session before and after the pitch session.** ▶ **See how our pitch nights look:** https://vimeo.com/877496618 **💡 What to expect:** * **Startups pitch live and receive focused feedback** from angels and VC partners * **Structured networking session** before and after the pitches * Entrepreneurs, startup founders, and operators are joining to network, exchange ideas, and build strong connections * Active investors and venture scouts joining to discover the best startups early **🤝 Who you will meet at the event:** * Founders * Investors, VC partners, Venture Scouts * Marketers, Salespeople, Business Advisors * Industry Disruptors * AI Experts * Entrepreneurs from Europe, Asia, and the United Kingdom **💼 We Welcome New Investors:** We invite investors to our event to expand their network, get acquainted with new startups, evaluate them, share feedback, and participate in discussions with early-stage and serial founders. We offer **complimentary tickets to institutional investors, angels, and venture scouts** with a proven track record. Please [apply via Luma](https://luma.com/nff43vdg) or send us an email so we can issue the ticket. If you'd like to **access our database of promising startups** or **provide mentorship support to our best startups**, please fill out this short [Investor Application Form](https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSdn1s8f5_R3iaqYoJ4aU2q1IxcFXIZIQElD6cEcv8YkRQhaUA/viewform), and our team will contact you. **🎤 Want to Pitch?** A limited number of founders will have the opportunity to pitch their startup or business **to a panel of investors and experts.** 4-6 selected founders will pitch their startup, followed by a short Q&A where participants can ask questions and share feedback. Apply by filling out the [Pitch Application Form](https://forms.gle/CuscVQibyXBbi1Fv7) and sending us your pitch deck. Spots are limited, and we select founders in advance. To maintain high-quality pitches, you are required to present with a pitch deck. We will share our **pitching guide** and, if you'd like, **coach you** so you're fully prepared for pitch night. 🏆 **The best startups will be featured** across our social media and included in our **investor newsletter.** **Requirements for attendees:** * Dress code: smart casual. Bring good energy. **🎟 Join our event and secure your ticket today!** **About us:** [Startup Valley](https://startupvalley.club/) is a global event organizer hosting pitch nights in 25 cities since 2023. Since then, **we have hosted 850 events for 40,000 attendees**. Over these years, we connected countless outstanding early-stage startups to serious investors, and we are not planning to stop. We maintain strategic partnerships with VC funds in the US, Europe, and Asia to support our community. Do you have a **question, a partnership proposal, or want to clarify something**? Reach us at hello@startupvalley.club **Agenda** * 18:00–18:30 — **Registration**: Guests register, receive badges, and event programs. This is an opportunity for casual networking, making first connections, and preparing for the event. * 18:30–19:00 — **Event Kickoff & Interactive Networking**: Official welcome from the organizers with a brief overview of the event goals and schedule. Interactive networking session to connect with key contacts. * 19:00–19:50 — **Startup Pitch Session**: Startups present their projects to investors and experts. Each team has 5 minutes to pitch, covering the project’s core idea, business model, and target market. * 19:50–21:00 — **Chill & Networking**: Participants enjoy casual conversations with investors, discuss collaboration opportunities, and exchange ideas over refreshments. **FAQ** **Can I pitch?** Yes! To pitch, please purchase a Pitch Ticket and fill out the Pitch Application Form. We will contact you to discuss and approve your pitch. The pitch duration is 5 minutes. You will also have some time to answer questions from the audience. **How does the pitch go?** Selected founders present on stage to the audience and the investors in the room. You get 5 minutes to pitch your idea, business model, target market, and investment ask, followed by a short Q&A. The best startups are featured across our social media channels and in the investor newsletter. **Who will I meet?** Founders, angel investors, VC partners, venture scouts, AI experts, engineers, operators, marketing and sales experts, and international entrepreneurs from across Europe, Asia, and the US. **Do investors get free tickets?** Yes! Please apply via Luma (the link is in the event description) or email hello@startupvalley.club, and we will issue a complimentary ticket for you and your team. **Can I request a refund?** Yes. Refunds are available if requested at least 1 day before the event start time. Please submit the refund request on the platform where you purchased your ticket, or email us at hello@startupvalley.club * ![Image 8: Photo of the user ](https://secure.meetupstatic.com/photos/member/b/1/c/0/thumb_325305504.jpeg?w=48) * ![Image 9: Photo of the user ](https://secure.meetupstatic.com/photos/member/5/7/7/9/thumb_272182393.jpeg?w=48) * ![Image 10: Photo of the user ](https://secure.meetupstatic.com/photos/member/4/9/c/2/thumb_260058882.jpeg?w=48) 7 attendees](https://www.meetup.com/startups-and-tech-events-in-amsterdam/events/316164535/?eventOrigin=group_upcoming_events)

Add to Calendar 09/17/2026 9:00 AM 09/18/2026 4:00 PM Amstersdam TECHSPO Amstersdam 2026  

Where Business, Tech and Innovation Collide in Amstersdam!

TECHSPO Amstersdam 2026 is a two day technology expo taking place September 17th - 18th, 2026 at the Hilton Amsterdam Hotel, Amsterdam, The Netherlands. TECHSPO Amstersdam brings together developers, brands, marketers, technology providers, designers, innovators and evangelists looking to set the pace in our advanced world of technology. Exhibitors showcase the next generation of technology & innovation, including; Internet, Mobile, Adtech, Martech and SaaS technologies. Be prepared to be inspired, amazed and educated on how these evolving technologies will impact your business for the better.

As part of TECHSPO Amstersdam is a limited attendance event, DigiMarCon Europe 2026 Digital Marketing Conference (https://digimarconeurope.com). If the conference is where the learning, theory and inspiration happens, then the TECHSPO floor is where the testing, networking and product interaction takes place.

The TECHSPO floor is free to attend (for a limited time)! Register today! For more details visit https://techspoamsterdam.nl/.

 Hilton Amsterdam Hotel, Amsterdam, The Netherlands.
